title.zh: Consensys splits MetaMask from institutional and Ethereum infrastructure businesses
title.en: Consensys splits MetaMask from institutional and Ethereum infrastructure businesses

current_state.zh: Consensys将拆分为两家公司：现有实体更名为MetaMask，由Joe Lubin担任董事长兼CEO；新成立的Consensys将专注于以太坊协议和机构基础设施，由Mike Kriak担任CEO，David Cunningham担任总裁，Lubin担任执行董事长。预计2026年底完成。
current_state.en: Consensys is splitting into two: the existing entity will be renamed MetaMask under Joe Lubin as Chairman and CEO; the new Consensys will focus on Ethereum protocols and institutional infrastructure, led by CEO Mike Kriak, President David Cunningham, and Executive Chairman Joe Lubin. Completion expected by end of 2026.

updates.title_zh: Consensys Software Inc. Splits In Two, Rebrands As MetaMask
updates.title_en: Consensys Software Inc. Splits In Two, Rebrands As MetaMask
updates.what_changed_zh: 新故事明确了拆分后的具体安排：钱包业务保留在现有实体中并更名为MetaMask，由Joe Lubin担任CEO；机构业务和以太坊基础设施（包括Linea、Besu）将移入新成立的保留Consensys名称的公司。
updates.what_changed_en: The story clarifies the split structure: the wallet business remains in the existing entity which renames to MetaMask with Joe Lubin as CEO; institutional business and Ethereum infrastructure (including Linea, Besu) move to a newly formed company retaining the Consensys name.
updates.current_state_zh: Consensys正拆分为两家公司：钱包业务保留在现有实体中并更名为MetaMask，由Joe Lubin担任CEO；机构和以太坊基础设施业务（包括Linea、Besu）将移入新成立的保留Consensys名称的公司。预计2026年底完成。
updates.current_state_en: Consensys is splitting into two: the wallet business remains in the existing entity which renames to MetaMask with Joe Lubin as CEO; institutional and Ethereum infrastructure businesses (including Linea and Besu) will move to a new company retaining the Consensys name. Completion expected by end of 2026.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Consensys splits into two companies, with the wallet business rebranding as MetaMask and the rest keeping the Consensys name, expected to complete by end of 2026.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Consensys splits into two companies, with the wallet business rebranding as MetaMask and the rest keeping the Consensys name, expected to complete by end of 2026.

updates.title_zh: Consensys Is Splitting in Two as MetaMask Goes Its Own Way
updates.title_en: Consensys Is Splitting in Two as MetaMask Goes Its Own Way
updates.what_changed_zh: 新成立的Consensys公司领导层确定：Mike Kriak担任CEO，David Cunningham担任总裁，Joe Lubin担任执行董事长；同时MetaMask的Joe Lubin担任董事长兼CEO。
updates.what_changed_en: The new Consensys leadership is set: Mike Kriak as CEO, David Cunningham as President, and Joe Lubin as Executive Chairman; additionally, Joe Lubin serves as both Chairman and CEO of MetaMask.
